settings.heading: One patient stitch at a time
settings.text: The tailorbird is a tiny songbird that stitches leaves together to build its nest, one patient stitch at a time. I make jewellery the same way.

settings.placeholder: Wide shot of the maker at the kitchen table in Yorkshire, beads, daylight, a cup of tea, 2400 × 1000 px

settings.heading: Hello, I'm Brittany
settings.text:
Every piece is stitched by hand from natural stone, clay and glass, so no two are quite alike and each is made to last. I hope yours feels like it was made just for you, because it was.

[A few lines in your own words: how you started making, what you love about beads, and a favourite piece. Keep it short and chatty, like you're talking across the stall.]

Tailorbird is slow-made. That means made with intention, by hand, to last for years, not a season. Nothing is rushed or mass-made.
